conditions: The same 87 structural candidates are reparsed with the frozen Stanza model; association counts exclude the target document; no validation-reserve body is read
observable: Normalized entropy and best-versus-second margin over right-headed word-level bracketings
expected_if_focal: The reader example is above the pooled median for bracketing entropy and below the pooled median for margin; at least eight high-competition documents occur across at least three sources
expected_if_rivals: H-SEMANTIC allows a low-entropy example; H-TERM predicts high scores concentrate in names or unsupported domain terms; H-PARSER predicts instability or alignment failure
falsifier: The reader example is below the entropy median or above the margin median after successful alignment, or fewer than eight multi-source high cases exist
indeterminate_result: Parser alignment or cross-fitted association coverage fails for the example or most candidates
boundary_conditions: Post-period development and discovery documents represented by the frozen 87-candidate input
uncertainty: Corpus association is sparse and English bracketing methods may not transfer to Chinese

conditions: Anchor variables and cross-document source support are computed without manual candidate deletion
observable: Composition of the high-competition stratum by proper-name numeric ASCII quoted-title and cross-source term-support variables
expected_if_focal: High scores are enriched among anchored or low-coverage sequences and lack an unanchored multi-source subgroup
expected_if_rivals: H-BRACKET predicts a reproducible unanchored subgroup; H-SEMANTIC predicts difficulty can remain in familiar non-name words even when term support is adequate
falsifier: At least four unanchored high cases occur across at least three sources while anchored negative controls show materially lower entropy
indeterminate_result: The parser does not preserve names or the corpus is too small to estimate cross-source support
boundary_conditions: Same frozen candidate pool and leave-one-document-out counts
uncertainty: Anchor metadata are imperfect diagnostics rather than gold labels

conditions: A later intervention compares boundary-only unpacking with an independently frozen explicit-relation edit while preserving source propositions
observable: Blinded willingness-to-continue preference and deterministic preservation checks
expected_if_focal: Explicit relation wording improves preference beyond boundary-only rearrangement when the hidden relation is recoverable from source context
expected_if_rivals: H-BRACKET predicts boundary-only unpacking is sufficient in high-entropy cases; H-TERM predicts neither edit consistently helps established terms
falsifier: Boundary-only unpacking performs as well as explicit relation wording across independently selected high-entropy items without preservation loss
indeterminate_result: The source does not determine a unique relation or the two edit versions differ in factual content
boundary_conditions: Future multi-reader intervention only after a computational gate passes
uncertainty: No effect magnitude is assumed and this prediction is not tested in the computational probe

conditions: Passage-level compositional features are held from the existing frozen vector and are not retuned
observable: Association between passage-level load and future blinded preference after accounting for target bracketing measurements
expected_if_focal: Difficulty tracks clause or proposition load rather than the local nominal target
expected_if_rivals: H-BRACKET predicts local structural edits help after global load is held comparable
falsifier: A bounded local edit improves preference in matched passages while non-target passage load remains unchanged
indeterminate_result: No future independent reader sample or insufficient variation in global load
boundary_conditions: Future held-out passages and multiple readers
uncertainty: Existing generic decompression split three to three and does not settle this rival
